description: This Java class is a REST API resource for managing Buy Down Fee amortization details associated with loans in the Fineract project. It provides endpoints to retrieve Buy Down Fee amortization details by loan ID, external ID, and loan transaction ID, including various methods to fetch data using different identifier combinations and return serialized JSON responses.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class providing endpoints to access Buy Down Fee amortization details for loans, identified by various parameters, within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveLoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetails
methods.description: Fetches the list of Buy Down Fee amortization details for a specific loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: retrieveLoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetailsByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches Buy Down Fee amortization details for a loan identified externally by externalId.

methods.name: retrieveBuyDownFeesAllocationData
methods.description: Fetches amortization allocation data for a specific loan and transaction, or external IDs, and serializes as JSON.

methods.name: getBuyDownFeesAllocationDataByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves Buy Down Fee allocation data for a loan specified by external ID and transaction ID.

methods.name: getBuyDownFeesAllocationDataByTransactionExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves Buy Down Fee allocation data for a loan ID and Transaction external ID.

methods.name: getBuyDownFeesAllocationDataByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieves Buy Down Fee allocation data based on both external IDs for loan and transaction.
